errors.evidence: The chart shows four categories (models) on the horizontal axis, not five.
The description incorrectly lists two items from the legend as categories on the horizontal axis. The categories are the RAG models (e.g., Qwen2-1.5B-IT).
The model name on the x-axis is "Qwen2-7B-IT", not "Owen2-7B-IT".
The description omits one of the four models from the x-axis: "Gemma2-9B-IT".
The labeled tick intervals on the y-axis are 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80), not 10.
The description fails to mention that the chart uses a grouped bar structure, where six bars are clustered together for each model on the x-axis. This is a primary structural feature.
There is no series named "ARC-JSD - Sample" in the chart's legend or data.
The ARC-JSD models are represented by shades of blue, not green.
